items.title: Introducing improvements to the fine-tuning API and expanding our custom models program
items.summary: We’re adding new features to help developers have more control over fine-tuning and announcing new ways to build custom models with OpenAI.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI宣布对其微调API进行多项功能升级，旨在为开发者提供更精细的模型控制手段。同时，公司扩展了定制模型计划，支持开发者构建更符合特定业务需求的专属模型。原始信息显示：We’re adding new features to help developers have more control over fine-tuning and announcing new ways to build custom models with OpenAI.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Introducing improvements to the fine-tuning API and expanding our custom models program”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI更新了微调API并扩展了定制模型计划，为开发者提供了更强的模型控制能力。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
